summary: IPC Alternative Real Estate Income Trust, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to report a routine distribution to stockholders. The Board authorized per-share distributions for Class T ($0.1042 gross, $0.0165 fee, $0.0877 net), Class D ($0.1042 gross, $0.0049 fee, $0.0993 net), Class I ($0.1042 gross, no fee, $0.1042 net), and Class X-1 ($0.1042 gross, no fee, $0.1042 net). Record date is June 30, 2026, payable on or about July 6, 2026 in cash or reinvested. No classes S, X-2, or A were outstanding. This is an ordinary capital return, not a special situation.
